name: Ken Kagami
introduction: Contemporary Artist. Born in Tokyo, 1974. Participated in numerous art exhibitions all over the world. Recently intends to use material known well in the world of art. Even trash or motives that don't seem to produce artisty are forcibly used to create such series as bronze works referring to the art history. In 2010, opened his own store "Strange Store" in Daikanyama selling his creations and secondhand cloths.
